name: Touch of Weakness
label: Quest
description: Touch of Weakness: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You be far from home out here in the Bloodhoof Village, friend. I be sent here to find priests of my own tribe to send back to speak to our leaders, but that not mean I cannot help you too.
I hear word that your head priestess spirit want all Forsaken to come to her--there are things you must learn.
Go to meet Aelthalyste in the War Quarter in that city of yours.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
